entry.name: counter
entry.digest: Keep count based on bang messages
entry.description: Outputs the current count of bang message constrained to a specified range. Can be set to count up, down, or up-then-down.

arguments.name: options
arguments.digest: Function depends on number of arguments
arguments.description: If there is only one argument, it sets an initial maximum count value for. If there are two arguments, the first number sets an initial minimum value, and the second number sets an initial maximum value. If there are three arguments, the first number specifies the direction of the count, the second number is the minimum, and the third number is the maximum. If there are no arguments, the direction is up, the minimum is 0, and the maximum is 2,147,483,647 (the largest possible 32-bit signed integer).

messages.name: bang
messages.description: In left inlet: Sends out the current count of themessages received in the left inlet.In left-middle inlet: Changes the direction of the count.In middle inlet: Resets the count to its specified minimum value, which will be sent out the next time ais received in the left inlet.In right-middle inlet: Resets the count to its specified minimum value, and sends out that value immediately.In right inlet: Resets the count to its specified maximum value, which is sent out immediately.

messages.name: carrybang
messages.digest: Change carry output to a bang message
messages.description: In left inlet: Causesto send aout the right-middle outlet when the count is going upward and reaches its maximum limit, and causesto send aout the left-middle outlet when the count is going downward and reaches its minimum limit. (By default, counter sends out the numberin those situations, instead of.) The state of themessage is saved along with the patcher it is used in.

messages.name: carryint
messages.digest: Change carry output to an int message
messages.description: In left inlet: Undoes the effect of a previously receivedmessage. Resets the counter to send the numbersandout the left-middle and right-middle outlets (instead of) to signal when the counter reaches and leaves its minimum and maximum values. The state of themessage is saved along with the patcher it is used in.

messages.name: dec
messages.description: In left inlet: Decrements the counter (downward) and sends out the new value, regardless of the direction in which the object has been set to count ordinarily.

messages.name: down
messages.description: In left inlet: Sets theto count in a downward direction.

messages.name: flags
messages.description: Themessage followed by two numbers will set the Underflow/Carry Mode and set the Minimum-Mode resetting capability. If the first number is 0,will output a 1 when it hits the maximum or else output a 0. If the first number is 1,will output awhen it hits the maximum. If the second number is 0, an integer in inlets 3 and 4 will override the minimum count temporarily. If the second number is 1, an integer in inlets 3 and 4 will change the minimum count permanently.

messages.name: float
messages.description: In all other inlets: Converted to.

messages.name: goto
messages.digest: Set the counter value with no output
messages.description: In left inlet: Same effect as.

messages.name: inc
messages.description: In left inlet: Increments the counter (upward) and sends out the new value, regardless of the direction in which the object has been set to count ordinarily.

messages.name: int
messages.description: In left inlet: Same effect as.In left-middle inlet: Sets the direction of the count.causesto count up,causes it to count down, andcauses it to count up and down.In middle inlet: The number sets the counter to a new value, to be sent out the next time ais received in the left inlet. If the number is less than the current minimum value, the minimum will be reset to that number. If the number is greater than the current maximum value, the counter will be set to that number, but the maximum value actually remains the same and the minimum is set equal to the maximum.In middle-right inlet: The number sets the counter to a new value and sends it out immediately. If the number is less than the current minimum value, the minimum will be reset to that number. If the number is greater than the current maximum value, the number is sent out, but the maximum value actually remains the same and the minimum is set equal to the maximum.In right inlet: Resets the maximum value sent out by. If the number is less than the current minimum, the maximum is equal to the minimum. If the minimum is subsequently changed to a value below the maximum value you input, theobjects retains the correct maximum value it received through this inlet. Unlike amessage, an int in this inlet does not cause theobject to output anything.

messages.name: jam
messages.digest: Set the counter value and cause output
messages.description: In left inlet: The word, followed by a number, sets the counter to that number and sends the number out immediately. If the number is outside the minimum and maximum count range, this message is ignored.

messages.name: max
messages.description: In left inlet: The wordfollowed by a number, resets the maximum value ofto that number. If the number is less than the current minimum value, the maximum is considered to be equal to the minimum, although the actual maximum value you set is stored inside theobject.

messages.name: min
messages.digest: Set the minimum value and cause output
messages.description: In left inlet: The wordfollowed by a number, resets the minimum value ofto that number, and causes theobject to set itself to that number and output immediately. If the number is greater than the current maximum value, the minimum is set equal to the maximum.

messages.name: set
messages.digest: Set the counter value with no output
messages.description: In left inlet: The word, followed by a number, sets the counter to that number, which will be sent out the next time ais received in the left inlet.

messages.name: setmin
messages.digest: Set the minimum value with no output
messages.description: In left inlet: The word, followed by a number, sets theobject's minimum count without affecting its current count value or causing any output.

messages.name: state
messages.digest: Print current state to the Max Console
messages.description: The messagewill cause theobject to report its current state to the Max Console.

messages.name: up
messages.description: In left inlet: Sets theto count in an upward direction.

messages.name: updown
messages.description: In left inlet: Sets theobject's direction so that it counts upward until it reaches the specified maximum, then counts down until it reaches the specified minimum, then up, then down, and so on.

Resets Counter to Number on Next Clock
